<!-- lang:zh -->
### ✨ 新增
- **锁屏充电详情**：实时显示功率 / 电压 / 电流 / 温度，显示字段与刷新间隔可调
- **锁屏通知指纹避让**：通知不再与屏下指纹区域重叠（跟随系统 / 不避让 / 始终避让）
- **状态栏图标调节器**：隐藏数据活动、网络类型、漫游、VoLTE、VoWiFi 图标，支持图标左置、堆叠信号与合成图标
- **相机**：解锁徕卡一瞬、智能构图、内容凭证、超高画质，新增街拍模式选择器与自定义水印
- **控制中心**：尺寸调节与圆角调节
- **电源键长按**：可自定义为即圈即搜或默认助理，带震动反馈
- **AOSP 还原**：AOSP 包安装器、电源菜单、音量面板、剪贴板编辑器与原生键盘
- **其他**：锁屏显示全部通知、移除超级岛白名单、玻璃材质调节、Quick Share、屏幕翻译，并补齐完整中文本地化

### 🔧 修复
- 图标调节器在 release（R8）构建下静默失效
- 堆叠信号渲染，并停止破坏蜂窝功能
- Extend Unlock（Smart Lock）信任派生，以及 AOSP 键盘 / 剪贴板的写回
- 相机、控制中心与 FCM 的适配与持久化
- 热路径性能优化

### ⚙️ 工程
- CI：运行单元测试与 lint，加固发布流程
- 更新依赖

<!-- lang:en -->
### ✨ Features
- **Lockscreen charging details**: live power / voltage / current / temperature, with configurable fields and refresh interval
- **Lockscreen notification fingerprint avoidance**: notifications no longer overlap the under-display fingerprint area (follow system / never / always)
- **Status bar icon tuner**: hide data activity, network type, roaming, VoLTE and VoWiFi icons; left-aligned icons, stacked signal and combined icons
- **Camera**: unlock Leica Moment, smart composition, content credentials and ultra-high quality, plus a street photography mode selector and custom watermarks
- **Control center**: adjustable size and corner radius
- **Long-press power button**: remap to Circle to Search or the default assistant, with haptic feedback
- **AOSP restoration**: AOSP package installer, power menu, volume panel, clipboard editor and stock keyboard
- **Other**: show all notifications on the lockscreen, remove the Super Island allowlist, glass material tuning, Quick Share, screen translation, and complete Simplified Chinese localization

### 🐛 Fixes
- The status bar icon tuner silently did nothing in release (R8) builds
- Stacked signal rendering, and it no longer breaks cellular connectivity
- Extend Unlock (Smart Lock) trust derivation, and AOSP keyboard / clipboard write-back
- Camera, control center and FCM compatibility and persistence
- Hot-path performance work

### ⚙️ Build & Chore
- CI: run unit tests and lint, harden the release pipeline
- Dependency updates
